hook: Stack Moonlight on your Hares, double it at the Full Moon, win big, then cash in the wipe.
loop: Buy and buff Hares, timing each buy to your Moon's phase.
Moonlight piles up through Waxing, then doubles at the Full Moon.
Win the Full and Waning fights; cash the New Moon wipe.

growth.line: Sawtooth on a four-turn Moon: spikes at Full, wiped at New; Moon-Scour lifts each peak.

feel.early: Small buffs; the first New Moon, turn 4, wipes them.
feel.mid: Timing buys, seating Cutters, cashing resets as gold or Jacks.
feel.late: Huge, rising Full Moon spikes; dark turns need holding.

stars.why: Doubles neighbours' light at the Full Moon; seating is the puzzle.
A Jack, not a Hare: keeps the light the coven loses.
Full Moon gift that grows each cycle, so peaks keep rising.

card_short.u01: When played: gains stats, double on a New Moon.
card_short.u02: Grows each turn; New Moon: lends half its lost light.
card_short.u03: Buffs your dimmest Hare; all other Hares at Full Moon.
card_short.u04: When played: Wax the Moon one phase.
card_short.u05: Once a turn, New Moon: gold for the light lost.
card_short.u06: Once a turn, selling a Hare Waxes the Moon.
card_short.u07: Jack: New Moon, keeps half the light its neighbours lost.
card_short.u08: Buffs three Hares each turn, more the later the cycle.
card_short.u09: Dying Hares pass half their light on, this fight.
card_short.u10: Buffs other Hares each turn; triple if this is brightest.
card_short.u11: Full Moon: becomes a copy of your biggest non-Hare.
card_short.u12: Full Moon: doubles the light of Hares next to it.
card_short.u13: Your Hares sell for extra gold by their light.
card_short.u14: Your Full Moon effects trigger twice.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: it and its neighbours share light.
card_short.u16: Big and Shielded on New and Waxing fights; Shields neighbours.
card_short.u17: Full Moon: buffs every Hare, more each Full Moon.
card_short.u18: Every Moon phase change buffs all your Hares.
card_short.u19: New Moon: summons a Jack; non-Hares keep half lost light.
card_short.x01: A 2/2 Jack that keeps everything it is given.
card_short.x02: Rule: Old Wat is in the Hare pool, not a Hare.
card_short.x03: Rule: slot auras stay; Harvest Supper on Hares is Moonlight.
card_short.x04: Rule: golden Hares still lose Moonlight at the New Moon.
card_short.x05: Rule: what Silverpenny copies and when she changes back.

builds.name: The Full Moon
builds.line: Pure Hares: stack light, double it with Cutters and Waxwell.

builds.name: The Fast Moon
builds.line: Sell lit Hares to Wax; more Full Moons, more gold.

builds.name: The Lending House
builds.line: Hand Hare light to another tribe's units, who keep it.

liked: All three picked Chalk-Cutter and Old Wat: a seating puzzle and a built-in loophole.
Every buy becomes a timing call; no current tribe treats time like this.
worries: Dame Waxwell with Chalk-Cutters can hit thousands of light; trigger order is unwritten.
Mother Meikle Care banks doubled light permanently, more each cycle; also watch Ringside Bookie.
changed: Dusk-Runner now guards the real dark turns: New and Waxing.
Spring-Ring Jill rewards a New Moon buy instead of doing nothing.
The Hare in the Moon's New Moon gift now lasts the whole cycle.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; ranked first of three Moon Hare designs. For players who enjoy timing spikes and seating puzzles.
